comment: The panel prints INV OUT where the parameter is named Invert Old Data and the README calls it INV OLD; all three are the same switch, and the code inverts the bit shifted out of the last stage before it re-enters the first. The README says the EXT CHANCE input replaces the internal noise for both the Chance and the Change comparators; the code uses it only for Chance, with the comment "Always compare against White Noise" on the Change comparison at src/Nosering.cpp:120. The INT_RATE knob is configured with a " Hz" suffix and no display base, so its tooltip reads 0 Hz to 14 Hz for a clock of 1Hz to 16384Hz, itself capped at 10000Hz. Index order is not panel order in either direction: the clock input is index 2 at the top and the noise output is index 2 above the two register outputs. Every port has a jack, and all three outputs are written every sample whether or not anything is patched.
